areaDescription: A labyrinthine district of ever-shifting shadows and illusion-draped corridors, the Shrouded Psiumbra pulses with psychic energies that warp perception and lure the unwary into revels of madness. Sinister music and muffled laughter echo beneath the gilded arches, masking the predatory presence of mind flayers and their enthralled masqueraders.

map.notes: Extended schema with AI-friendly navigation fields

locations.name: Veilpiercer Antechamber
locations.description: This sumptuous antechamber welcomes newcomers to the Mind Flayer’s Masquerade Hall. Gilded arches soar overhead, veiled in gauzy illusions that shift with every glance. The very air thrums with psychic resonance, and shadowy figures in elaborate masks mingle beneath opalescent chandeliers whose crystal drops flicker with images of forgotten faces. Subtle illusions distort depth and distance, making navigation both mesmerizing and perilous.

npcs.name: Masquerade Steward
npcs.description: A tall figure in an intricate mirrored mask, greeting arrivals with a smile that never quite reaches their eyes. The steward offers cryptic advice, subtly probing the party's intentions and mental fortitude.
npcs.attitude: Polite and enigmatic, loyal to the Hall’s true masters.

monsters.name: Illusionary Shadow Dancers
monsters.description: Semi-corporeal entities spawned from lingering psychic energies, disrupting intruders’ senses and movements.

lootTable: Phantasmal Token (can reveal one illusion in the Psiumbra, single use)
Fine masquerade mask (25 gp, social advantage in this district)
Psychic Residue Gemstone (worth 50 gp to collectors of the arcane)
plotHooks: The steward hints at a 'guest of honor' whose presence is disrupting the masquerade.
Whispers among the guests mention a vault where the mind flayers store their most coveted memories.
locations.dmInstructions: Set the tone of shifting reality—emphasize confusing perspectives and atmospheric tension. If the party lingers or acts suspiciously, the shadow dancers coalesce to observe or challenge them. Illusions may briefly show NPCs the party recognizes, or enemies from their past.

doors.name: Opalescent Archway
doors.description: A tall archway overlaid with shimmering illusions, leading east deeper into the Hall.

dcChecks: Perception DC 16: Notice that some of the guests are not real, but psychic projections.
Arcana DC 15: Identify the presence of a subtle mind-affecting field that clouds memory.
locations.accessibility: Normal access from the district’s main corridor; the ever-shifting walls might disorient newcomers.

features.name: Interesting Architecture
features.description: Tall gilded arches and mirrored pillars refract light into impossible patterns, distorting space.

features.name: Illusionary Chandeliers
features.description: Crystals flicker with shifting faces and scenes from distant memories.

encounters.name: Shadow Dancer Ambush
encounters.description: If the party fails to blend in or draws attention, the illusionary dancers attempt to entrap them within psychic mazes.

locations.adventureSummary: The party is subtly assessed upon entry, with the steward offering information or warnings based on their actions. The antechamber sets the hall’s eerie tone and offers clues to deeper dangers.

locations.name: Hall of Shifting Truths
locations.description: A broad corridor lined with ever-morphing murals and floating banners, each depicting contradictory versions of Numillian’s history. The floor undulates slightly, as if alive, and reality itself feels thin. Conversations echo with double-meanings and psychic aftershocks. Here, mind games and psychic duels are as common as masked balls.

npcs.name: Masked Duelist
npcs.description: A flamboyant swordsman in a shifting, glass-like mask, eager to test the wit and will of outsiders through psychic contests or riddles.
npcs.attitude: Challenging but not overtly hostile; respects cleverness and mental strength.

monsters.name: Minor Mind Flayer Thralls
monsters.description: Enthralled party guests, appearing as revelers until provoked.

lootTable: Memory Fragment (consumable, gain fleeting insight into the Hall’s secrets)
Silvered rapier with an inscription in Deep Speech (75 gp)
plotHooks: Murals hint at a secret route to the Mindsunder Vault, only visible to those who solve the duelist’s riddle.
A psychic tremor reveals that an important guest is being ‘rewritten’ in the next chamber.
locations.dmInstructions: Encourage players to engage in social or psychic tests (contests of Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma). The Hall can subtly alter facts or memories, keeping players on edge. If players lose a contest, introduce minor temporary conditions such as confusion or fleeting paranoia.

doors.name: Mural Gate
doors.description: A door disguised as part of a shifting mural, leading further east.

doors.name: Antechamber Entry
doors.description: Open arch leading back to the Veilpiercer Antechamber.

traps.damage: 2d6 psychic (shifting hallucinations overwhelm the mind if the Mural Gate is forced without solving the riddle)

dcChecks: Investigation DC 15: Find inconsistencies in the murals that hint at the secret door.
Insight DC 17: Discern that the duelist is testing more than physical skill—he’s probing for psychic strength.
locations.accessibility: Open from the Antechamber, but progress east requires solving the duelist’s riddle or bypassing the trap.

features.name: Interesting Architecture
features.description: The corridor’s width and decor shift subtly, never appearing exactly the same twice.

features.name: Signs Of Age
features.description: Some murals flicker to reveal much older and darker histories beneath.

encounters.name: Psychic Duel
encounters.description: The duelist challenges a party member to a contest of riddles or mental fortitude; success gains safe passage and a clue, failure risks psychic backlash.

locations.adventureSummary: This hall tests the party’s wits and resolve. Success here opens hidden paths and reveals truths about the hall’s ever-shifting nature.

locations.name: Mindsunder Vault
locations.description: Deep within the Masquerade Hall, this chamber feels colder and heavier. Walls of obsidian glass reflect not only visitors’ faces but their innermost fears and aspirations. Psychic motes drift in the still air, distorting reality. This vault stores the ‘prized’ memories, secrets, and psychic remnants harvested from revelers—some contained in crystalline reliquaries, others haunting the space as faint, tormented echoes.

npcs.name: Mind Flayer Archivist
npcs.description: A gaunt, tentacled figure in tattered ceremonial finery, cataloging and curating psychic treasures. The archivist is aware of the party’s approach, both physically and mentally.
npcs.attitude: Coldly curious; prefers to negotiate or manipulate unless threatened.

monsters.name: Spectral Memory Wraiths
monsters.description: Remnants of lost minds, twisted into aggressive psychic entities.

lootTable: Memory Prism (contains a vital clue to the mind flayer’s true motives)
Reliquary Key (opens a hidden cache elsewhere in the Hall)
Psionic Focus Crystal (acts as a spellcasting focus for psychic magic)
plotHooks: The archivist offers a deal—trade a memory for information about Numillian’s illusions.
A spectral voice pleads for release, offering to reveal secrets of the vault if freed from psychic bondage.
locations.dmInstructions: The archivist is a formidable social and magical adversary, preferring to manipulate or strike bargains. If attacked, the wraiths are summoned for defense. Use the memory trade as a roleplay opportunity, with meaningful consequences for what the party offers.

doors.name: Obsidian Vault Door
doors.description: A heavy, seamless panel of black glass, etched with writhing psychic runes. Opens only to the reliquary key or by solving a psychic puzzle.
doors.trap: Psychic backlash: If forced or opened improperly, the intruder must make a DC 17 Intelligence save or take 3d6 psychic damage and suffer disadvantage on all Intelligence saves for 1 hour.

doors.name: Mural Gate
doors.description: A secret door leading west back to the Hall of Shifting Truths.

traps.damage: 3d6 psychic (from the Vault Door’s defensive enchantment)

dcChecks: Arcana DC 16: Identify the wraiths as psychic remnants, not true undead.
History DC 18: Recognize the reliquaries as containing memories from powerful Numillian figures.
locations.accessibility: Accessible from the Hall of Shifting Truths, but the vault door poses a significant barrier.

features.name: Dust
features.description: A thin layer of silvery dust covers the floor, glittering with psychic motes.

features.name: Obsidian Mirrors
features.description: Reflect not only physical form, but fragments of memory and emotion.

encounters.name: Archivist Bargain
encounters.description: The mind flayer archivist offers to trade secrets for precious memories or tries to trap intruders within the vault.

locations.adventureSummary: The vault is a crucible of memory and temptation. The archivist may become an ally or formidable foe, and the psychic treasures here can change the party’s future choices.
